verdict.rationale: Meltano's plugin architecture (extractors/loaders) and library of 600+ connectors, plus the claim of building connectors 'from any source to any destination,' support the general idea of portable pipelines across warehouses/lakes, and the loader/config CLI abstracts destination swapping. However, the evidence pack never names Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, or object storage specifically as supported loaders, nor shows a hands-on example of switching destinations without pipeline changes. Missing for 10: explicit named connector listings for the major warehouses/lakes, and independent confirmation of true 'swap without changing pipeline' behavior.
